question: Do .uno:DefaultBullet, .uno:DefaultNumbering and .uno:StyleApply reach a LibreOfficeKit client, what strings does StyleApply carry, and do the paragraph/list fixed commands acknowledge?
whyNative: A negative result from the WASM profile alone cannot separate 'core never sends this' from 'our build does not receive it'. Finding 016 needed a native comparison to settle exactly that, so E2-A runs native before wiring any completion barrier.

build.note: Same native build used for the Finding 016 comparison; not rebuilt for E2.

fixture.layout: Heading 1 / plain paragraph / list with two items / tail paragraph

validityGuard.method: saveAs to ODT after every dispatch; postcondition read from content.xml, not from the callbacks under test
validityGuard.why: A paragraph-format command does not change document text, so text length cannot be used as the guard the way Finding 016 used it.
validityGuard.result: all six saves returned true and were inspected

perCommand.postcondition: paragraph left the list, style back to Standard
perCommand.note: success:false contradicts the saved document -- see finding 020
UI alias, not a dispatchable slot -- see finding 019
three different strings for one style: sent 'Text body', stored 'Text_20_body', reported 'Body Text'

consequences.a2Gate: passed for lists and for parameterised StyleApply; the paragraph-style aliases fail for a different reason than assumed
consequences.specPremiseOverturned: SPEC-E2-A entered assuming these commands emit no UNO command result at all. Four of five dispatchable forms do. The real defects are a wrong command mapping (019) and an untrustworthy success flag (020).
consequences.barrierDesignRevision: The UNO command result carries commandName and so solves attribution, which the state broadcast alone cannot. But success/wasModified are demonstrably wrong for two commands, so the result cannot carry truth. Completion must require both: the matching command result for attribution and the expected state for truth.

notValidated: Whether the same states and results arrive in the WASM profile under Chrome and Firefox.
Whether StyleApply display names change with UI locale; this run used the default locale only.
Whether the state can arrive before the UNO command result under load, which would change the barrier's ordering assumption.
Whether list toggling triggers the Finding 012 teardown class on close.
